dimensions.gloss: Which specific task or role in producing the work a named contributor performed (e.g. conceptualisation, data collection, writing, coordination, resources, final approvals), drawn from several enumerated author-contribution lists.
variants: coordination and communication in the team
designing the review and performing the literature search
documenting and storing the sources for review
dimensions.note: Merges items from at least three distinct numbered author-contribution taxonomies (a CRediT-like list, and two other journal-specific numbered lists, one of which is duplicated by an overlapping second extraction pass). Each item names one value within a single 'who did what' axis rather than a distinct axis of disclosure, so they were treated as one dimension.

dimensions.gloss: Which step of a sequential four-step practice for identifying, depositing, and citing physical or data samples a given practice belongs to.
variants: assign and/or use identifiers for samples
publish and cite samples in datasets

dimensions.gloss: Whether a specific content section of a prediction-model study (e.g. predictors, missing data, model performance, implications) was reported or not.
Whether a dataset or its components can be located and identified, through repository deposit, persistent identifiers, article linkage, timestamps, and bibliographic metadata.
variants: the dataset is deposited in an open repository
the associated article is cited or linked
the dataset is assigned a unique, citable and persistent identifier (i.e., doi)
all compounds are assigned a unique, citable and persistent identifier (i.e., smiles or inchi + inchi key)
data-time stamps for creation, deposition and versions of the dataset are included
bibliographic metadata are available (authors, contributors, affiliations, funding source)
dimensions.note: Grouped on the 'Find_' item codes visible in the source quotes (e.g. 'Find_1', 'Find_4'), which is the scheme's own grouping rather than an imported framework.

dimensions.gloss: Whether a deposited dataset is organised and documented well enough to be accessed and used once it has been found.
variants: coherent file structure (logically grouped and labelled files)
dimensions.note: Grouped on the 'Access_' item code visible in one source quote ('Access_3'); the other two items share the same file-organisation/documentation character.

dimensions.gloss: Whether the data and its metadata use standard, machine-readable formats and describe instruments, experiment parameters, and processing methods thoroughly enough to be combined or reprocessed.
variants: metadata describe instrument parameters (vendor, model, version, software)
original data are in standard open format(s)
metadata are in a machine-readable format (i.e., xml, json)

dimensions.gloss: Whether a dataset carries the format, licence, and code needed for someone else to reuse or reproduce the findings.
variants: original data are in reusable format
open licence information is available (i.e., cc or odc) under which data can be reused
code scripts necessary to reproduce findings are available

dimensions.gloss: Which layer or actor is responsible for controlling, governing, or verifying a system or process, ranging from design-stage controls through internal controls and governance bodies to independent external audit.
variants: the design of ai systems and training data
governance and oversight by management, audit committees, and regulators
dimensions.note: Close call: 'the design of AI systems and training data' concerns AI systems specifically while the other three concern financial-reporting control language; grouped because the source quotes read as sequential lettered items ('(c) governance and oversight...') of one assurance-chain list rather than separate axes.

dimensions.gloss: Which quality criterion a reviewed record was found to address, reported as a count/percentage of records.
dimensions.note: Close call: 'reliability' and 'integrity' are substantively different criteria; grouped only because both come from the same 'X was identified in N (%) of records' enumeration, implying they are values of one underlying tally axis rather than separate axes. Could reasonably be split into two singletons.

dimensions.gloss: Which category of knowledge-work task (transaction, integration, expert, collaboration) a case represents.
Which editorial action was taken on AI-assisted output, from accepting through light or substantial modification to rejecting.
Whether the perceived risk level of the task was high or low.
Whether the final prompt and the model/version (and settings) used were saved alongside the output as a provenance record.
Whether/how a team split work between content refinement and compliance/quality checking under deadline pressure.
